thread:
laura-ml: Quick check — finalizing onboarding for harbor-6b-lite. Legal flagged a license clause (models/harbor/LICENSE.md) and perf for longer contexts is noisy on a couple instance types. Who's owning the legal follow-up and infra perf triage?

omar-eng: I can take infra perf triage this morning. Can you drop the perf traces here? Any specific p95 SLO we should aim for?

laura-ml: thx. Target is p95 <= 220ms for 2k tokens on ded-rtx-a10. Here are recent microbench results: 2023-11-07 run.
```
model: harbor-6b-lite
batch: dynamic
seq: 2048
hw: rtx-a10-dedicated
p95: 340ms
notes: KV cache warm but kernel selection flips at step 512
```

priya-curation: FYI curation noticed tokenizer mismatch with our validation prompts (some non-breaking spaces). I'll clean prompt set unless legal holds.

legal-syd: Laura — I left a comment in the intake PR about the license: attribution + no-derivatives clause. For hosted catalog we need a compatibility note and clarified redistribution policy. I can draft language but need product sign-off.

laura-ml: @legal-syd thanks. Ben — can product/ops accept the compatibility note template for hosted?

ben-platform: @laura-ml from platform POV the no-derivatives clause is a red flag for hosting transforms/safety tuning. We can host a pinned, unmodified artifact behind dedicated access if product agrees. Technical constraint: quantized checkpoints we create are considered derived.

laura-ml: Understood. Priya, mark this as "license: restrictive" in the catalog metadata and add a recommended access level.

priya-curation: done — added metadata tag and flagged owner=laura-ml, ops-decision=required.

max-reliability: Omar — when you triage perf, please also check KV cache warmup variance. Last run shows high cold-start noise. Might be batching policy mismatch with stream callers.

omar-eng: On it. Quick plan: reproduce on staging, run kernel trace, and test these two configs: auto-batch 8 vs fixed-batch 4; kernel override gpt-optmz-v2. Will report by EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/harbor-6b-lite-staging (build 2023.11.07-rc3) — logs: https://ci.internal/reports/harbor-6b-lite/2023.11.07-rc3

laura-ml: small docs ask — @tess-docs can you add a note to /catalog/help about models with non-hosted/limited-hosting licenses so customers don't assume full hosted availability? Just 2 sentences + link to license field.

tess-docs: yep, will drop a short blurb and link to the license entry. ETA: this afternoon.

priya-curation: also added a perf-profile draft (low-latency, cost-optimized) and attached expected latency buckets. Need infra validation before promoting to verified.

laura-ml: great. Summary of owners: legal=legal-syd (draft language), infra=omar-eng (perf triage), curation=priya-curation (metadata + prompts), docs=tess-docs. Action items logged in intake PR. Anyone with blockers?

legal-syd: No blocker from legal after draft. Will wait for product sign-off to publish notes.

ben-platform: Blocker: we need a decision about quantized artifact hosting. If product wants us to provide quantized variants, legal must approve derived-artifact terms.

laura-ml: I'll bring the quantized-hosting question to product sync at 3pm. If product OKs restricted hosting, ops and legal will proceed.

omar-eng: Quick heads-up: reproducing the high p95 on staging now. Looks like kernel selection flips when context > 6k tokens, will attempt kernel-force override to stable-optmz and rerun.

curation-bot: reminder — intake PR #782 waiting: add license summary + perf validation. Due: 48h.

laura-ml: Thanks all. I'll post a short rollout plan after product sync. If anyone needs to pair on perf traces ping me or @omar-eng. :thumbsup:
